name: CTID ATT&CK ↔ VERIS Mapping
owner: Center for Threat-Informed Defense (CTID) — MITRE Engenuity
description: Mapping between VERIS Framework (Verizon Data Breach Investigations Report taxonomy) and MITRE ATT&CK 12.1. Three matrices: Enterprise, ICS, Mobile.
relationToCloudSecurity: Bridges incident-data taxonomies (VERIS) with adversary behavior (ATT&CK).

current_extraction.notes: Reference-only. Upstream publishes this mapping at mappings/veris/attack-12.1/ and retains prior versions (attack-9.0, attack-12.1, attack-16.1, attack-19.1). Fetch from upstream rather than relying on a copy here.

extraction_history.reason: Removed the committed mapping and reverted to reference-only, matching this document's already-declared desired_end_state. The snapshot mapped ATT&CK 12.1 against a current 19.2, and upstream retains every version we held (attack-9.0, attack-12.1, attack-16.1, attack-19.1) plus newer ones. Files remain in git history and S3.

notes: VERIS ↔ ATT&CK mapping across three matrices.

desired_end_state.notes: CTID mappings are Apache-2.0 and published upstream with prior versions retained (attack-9.0, attack-12.1, attack-16.1, attack-19.1), so a copy here drifts without adding anything. Stub points upstream.
